facts.text: The half-million-dollar switch at the Del Amo mall.
facts.why: The swap happens at a shopping mall and Jackie plans to keep about $500,000 of Ordell's money. The switch itself holds $50,000 plus the hidden half million. Close enough for a menu line.

facts.text: Serve the snacks when the money swap happens at the shopping mall.
facts.why: Jackie runs the bag swap with Melanie at the mall while Nicolette watches the food court. Fits.
